```{r}

# Load your filtered data
model_df <- read_csv(file.path(inference_data_dir, "hybrid_model_predictions.csv")) %>%
  filter(learner_segment_input == "model" & beta_method == "theta_betas")

# Parse the theta_betas predictions
parse_betas <- function(beta_str) {
  if (is.na(beta_str)) return(NULL)
  # Remove brackets and parse
  pairs <- str_extract_all(beta_str, "\\([0-9.]+,\\s*[0-9.]+\\)")[[1]]
  alphas <- str_extract(pairs, "^\\([0-9.]+") %>% str_remove("\\(") %>% as.numeric()
  betas <- str_extract(pairs, "[0-9.]+\\)$") %>% str_remove("\\)") %>% as.numeric()
  list(alpha = alphas, beta = betas)
}

# Compute expected payoffs for each play game
play_analysis <- model_df %>%
  filter(game == "play") %>%
  group_by(session_id, game_index, rollout_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # One row per play segment
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    parsed = map(theta_betas, parse_betas),
    alphas = map(parsed, ~.x$alpha),
    betas = map(parsed, ~.x$beta)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Expected payoff = alpha / (alpha + beta)
    expected_payoffs = map2(alphas, betas, ~.x / (.x + .y)),
    # Variance across arms (informativeness measure)
    payoff_variance = map_dbl(expected_payoffs, var),
    # Max expected payoff
    max_expected = map_dbl(expected_payoffs, max),
    # Min expected payoff  
    min_expected = map_dbl(expected_payoffs, min),
    # Range
    payoff_range = max_expected - min_expected
  )

# Plot variance over game_index
p_variance <- ggplot(play_analysis, aes(x = game_index, y = payoff_variance)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.2, width = 0.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", color = "red", size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "red", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Prediction Informativeness Over Time",
    subtitle = "Variance of expected payoffs across arms (higher = more informative)",
    x = "Game Index",
    y = "Variance of Expected Payoffs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_variance)
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(fig_dir, paste0(experiment_name, "_", version, "_variance.png")),
      plot = p_variance, width = 10, height = 8, bg = "white"
    )

# Summary statistics
print("Variance by game_index (are predictions getting less informative?):")
print(play_analysis %>%
  group_by(game_index) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_variance = mean(payoff_variance),
    mean_range = mean(payoff_range)
  ))
```

```{r}
# Parse true payoffs
parse_true_payoffs <- function(zone_bandit) {
  as.numeric(str_split(zone_bandit, ",")[[1]])
}

# Compute expected payoffs from alpha/beta
compute_expected <- function(beta_str) {
  parsed <- parse_betas(beta_str)
  if (is.null(parsed)) return(NULL)
  parsed$alpha / (parsed$alpha + parsed$beta)
}

# Analyze predictions vs true payoffs
correlation_analysis <- model_df %>%
  filter(game == "play") %>%
  group_by(session_id, game_index, zone_bandit, rollout_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    true_payoffs = map(zone_bandit, parse_true_payoffs),
    pred_payoffs = map(theta_betas, compute_expected),
    correlation = map2_dbl(pred_payoffs, true_payoffs, 
                          ~if(is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else cor(.x, .y))
  )

# Plot correlation over time
p_correlation <- ggplot(correlation_analysis, aes(x = game_index, y = correlation)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.2, width = 0.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", color = "blue", size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "blue", size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction Accuracy Over Time",
    subtitle = "Correlation between predicted and true payoffs",
    x = "Game Index",
    y = "Correlation"
  )

print(p_correlation)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(fig_dir, paste0(experiment_name, "_", version, "_correlation.png")),
    plot = p_correlation, width = 10, height = 8, bg = "white"
  )

# Summary
print("Mean correlation by game_index:")
print(correlation_analysis %>%
  group_by(game_index) %>%
  summarise(mean_corr = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE)))
```
